clean_repro.probe: POST /v2/vectordb/entities/insert with JSON field containing various data types (string, number, boolean, object, array)
clean_repro.observed: Insert succeeded for all data types. Query revealed data stored as STRING representations: meta='true' (boolean), meta='12345' (number), meta='{"nested": "object"}' (object), meta='["array", "value"]' (array)
clean_repro.evidence_cmd: curl insert with mixed JSON types, then query to verify storage format

source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:JSON 字段在 REST v2 API 中未经任何验证，直接将原始字符串转换为字节存储。没有 JSON 语法检查、类型验证或结构验证。

falsification.probe: Query inserted entities to verify actual storage format vs. expected JSON storage
falsification.observed: Data IS inserted but stored as STRING representations (meta='true', meta='12345', meta='{"nested": "object"}') instead of validated JSON. This confirms the defect: JSON field accepts non-JSON values without validation.

cognition_match.developer_quote: REST v2 API fails to properly serialize/deserialize complex data types
cognition_match.note: Hits BDP-001 pattern: REST v2 data type handling issues. The source code confirms JSON fields lack validation, matching the known blindspot area.

verdicts.rationale: REST v2 /entities/insert 接受 JSON 字段的非 JSON 值（布尔值、数字、字符串）而不验证，将它们存储为字符串表示而非有效 JSON。源代码证实了这一点：handler_v2.go:1563 调用 insert()，后者使用 utils.go:760-761 中的 checkAndSetData()，其中 DataType_JSON 案例仅执行 `reallyData[fieldName] = []byte(dataString)`，没有任何 JSON 语法验证。这是 'rest-v2-data-type-handling' 模式的一个实例，这是一个已知的开发者盲点（bug_shapes.json 显示有 26 个历史案例）。该缺陷影响数据完整性，因为存储类型不一致（布尔值变为字符串 'true'，数字变为字符串 '12345'）。

contract.explicit_requirement: milvus_behavioral_insert_then_get_001 - Inserted entities should be retrievable; milvus_type_json_001 - JSON scalar data type exists

physical.objective_constraint: JSON fields should contain valid JSON data (structured data format, not arbitrary primitive-to-string conversion)
